ingredients.name: cornflakes, crumbled, or regular bread crumbs

steps.instruction: Drizzle 1 tablespoon of lemon juice on 2 pounds of fish fillets.
Mix 1/4 cup of buttermilk, 2 drops of hot sauce and 1 teaspoon of garlic in a bowl.
Mix 1/4 teaspoon each of white pepper, salt and onion powder with 1/2 cup of cornflakes.
Spread the seasoned cornflakes on a plate.
Let a fillet sit briefly in the buttermilk mixture.
Coat the fillet on both sides with the seasoned crumbs.
steps.spoken: Coat the fillet on both sides with the seasoned crumbs. Let it stand briefly until the coating sticks to each side. Repeat for all the fillets.

steps.instruction: Arrange the fillets in a lightly oiled shallow baking dish.
steps.spoken: Arrange the fillets in a shallow baking dish lightly oiled with the vegetable oil.

steps.instruction: Bake for 20 minutes on the middle rack without turning.
